biomarkers.name: Molecular subgroups (WNT, SHH, Group 3, Group 4)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defines the four consensus molecular subgroups and is central to diagnosis and risk stratification. WNT: excellent prognosis, de-escalation trials. SHH: variable prognosis, with TP53-mutant SHH conferring very high risk. Group 3: generally poorest prognosis, especially with MYC amplification. Group 4: intermediate prognosis. Guides risk-adapted therapy

biomarkers.name: CTNNB1 (b2-catenin)  nuclear IHC
biomarkers.clinical_use: Marker of WNT subgroup; typically correlates with CTNNB1 mutation

biomarkers.name: MYCN amplification
biomarkers.clinical_use: Adverse prognostic feature, particularly in SHH and in subsets of Group 4

biomarkers.name: TP53 mutation (germline in Li-Fraumeni)
biomarkers.clinical_use: SHH-TP53-mutant defines a very high-risk subtype; consider germline testing for Li-Fraumeni syndrome

biomarkers.name: PTCH1, SMO, SUFU mutations (SHH pathway)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Support classification as SHH-activated medulloblastoma; SMO inhibitors (vismodegib, sonidegib) are relevant mainly for tumors with upstream SHH-pathway activation such as PTCH1 or SMO alterations, but not generally for SUFU-mutant tumors

biomarkers.name: Isochromosome 17q
biomarkers.prevalence: Common, especially in Group 4 and also seen in Group 3
biomarkers.clinical_use: Characteristic recurrent cytogenetic alteration in non-WNT/non-SHH medulloblastoma, especially Group 4

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Small round blue cell embryonal tumour of cerebellum with Homer-Wright rosettes, high mitotic and apoptotic index
variants: medulloblastoma with extensive nodularity (MBEN, infants, good prognosis)
large cell / anaplastic (poor prognosis, often associated with MYC amplification)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: All WHO grade 4; risk stratification by molecular subgroup + histology + metastasis + age

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Cold typically; molecular subgroups have distinct immune signatures
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Small round blue cell architecture; nodular pattern in desmoplastic variants

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Distinct precursor cells for each molecular subgroup: WNT (lower rhombic lip / dorsal brainstem progenitors), SHH (cerebellar granule neuron precursors), Group 3 (undetermined; proposed cerebellar stem/progenitor or photoreceptor-like lineage programs), Group 4 (likely glutamatergic lineage from upper rhombic lip / unipolar brush cell-related progenitors)
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Neuroectoderm  hindbrain (rhombic lip and external granule layer of developing cerebellum)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Undifferentiated embryonal small round blue cell tumour with variable neuronal differentiation (synaptophysin+ variable); Homer-Wright rosettes in some
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Four distinct molecular subgroups reflect distinct cells of origin and lineage programmes: WNT (best prognosis, CTNNB1-mutant, classically midline/dorsal brainstem-related), SHH (SHH-pathway activated, TP53 status prognostic), Group 3 (worst prognosis, often MYC-amplified, photoreceptor gene expression), Group 4 (most common, frequently isochromosome 17q)
